topic: Sabrina Ionescu getting locked up and stripped by a Filipino high school player during a camp in the Philippines.

hook.first_words: This is why WNBA players get hate.
hook.first_frame: Sabrina Ionescu dribbling against a male basketball player on court.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: This is why WNBA players get hate.

Sabrina Ionescu speaking into a mic during her basketball camp.
Sabrina receiving the ball and starting to dribble upcourt.
Filipino high schooler steals the ball from Sabrina and drives downcourt to score a layup.

script: This is why WNBA players get hate. During her camp in the Philippines, Sabrina Ionescu would get matched up against a Filipino high schooler. This kid would proceed to lock her up, even stealing the ball with ease, which began to make Sabrina very angry, because the same moves she used in the WNBA didn't work against the kid. Eventually, it got to a point where she elbowed the high schooler and crashed out.
what_makes_it_work: High-stakes controversial statement in the first second creates immediate intrigue.
Captivating story arc showing a pro star surprisingly getting outplayed by a high school player.
Fast cuts keep the viewer engaged throughout the 19-second video.
